_meta.method: programmatic zod-chain parse + manual SuperRefine transcription; verified against builder v4.13 TAGS list (exact match, 72 tags)
_meta.notes: Field composition: each tag spreads shared blocks (see _sharedBlocks) then overrides/extends. A field listed on the tag OVERRIDES the same field from a shared block. The type field (discriminator literal) is omitted from per-tag fields; the key of the tag entry IS the literal.
_meta._2026_08_26_scope_change: The per-tag `tags` block (72 entries: schemaName, composition, fields, defaults, enums) has been DELETED. It duplicated what is now generated from source into 45c_DATA_constructors.json -> unions.AllTags (73 members, each with discriminant, every field, prefault defaults and resolved enums). The hand copy had already drifted: it was missing `disarm`. Duplicating a generated shape is exactly how the AI rule shape was authored wrong and rejected live. THIS FILE NOW OWNS ONLY WHAT SOURCE CANNOT TELL YOU: cross-field rules, effect polarity, per-entity SuperRefine restrictions, and the dated behavioural laws.

_unionMembership.notes: SOURCE TRUTH: jutsu, item, bloodline, AND skilltree validators all use the SAME AllTags union (z.array(AllTags)). There is NO schema-level per-entity tag restriction. Per-entity restrictions come ONLY from the SuperRefine rules below.

_divergenceFromLiveObservation.claim: Earlier live testing (Mirror of Avarice, pre-Jul 2026) observed 400s applying clear/copy effects to items, recorded as 'clear/copy are jutsu-only'. Current source shows the union is shared and SuperRefineItem does NOT restrict clear/copy.
_divergenceFromLiveObservation.resolution: Treat current source as truth for the deployed version going forward; if an item with clear/copy 400s again, capture it: either the live deployment lags this source or the restriction lives elsewhere (e.g. editor UI only).

_divergenceFromLiveObservation2.claim: Live-verified rule (Tower builds): wound requires calculation percentage AND a statTypes array. Source schema: calculation is locked to percentage (matches) but statTypes is optional (IncludeStats block).
_divergenceFromLiveObservation2.resolution: Keep supplying statTypes on wound until a wound-without-statTypes save is tested; runtime damage calc may need it even if the write schema does not.

_unionMembership.allTags: SUPERSEDED: read the member list from 45c_DATA_constructors.json -> unions.AllTags. A hand copy drifted to 72 entries against source's 73 (missing 'disarm').

rules: clone or summon tag requires target EMPTY_GROUND
damage + move on the same action requires an AOE-type method
rollbloodline and removebloodline are FORBIDDEN on jutsu
at least one of cost (ryo), repsCost, seichiSilverCost must be > 0
noncombatconsumereward requires: itemType CONSUMABLE, target SELF, method SINGLE
rollbloodline / removebloodline require: itemType CONSUMABLE, target SELF, method SINGLE
unlockitemvariant requires: itemType CONSUMABLE, target SELF, method SINGLE, destroyOnUse true, preventBattleUsage true

_appliesTo: any effects array (jutsu, item, bloodline, skilltree)
rules: wound requires a damage or pierce effect on the SAME action
vamp requires a damage or pierce effect on the SAME action
clone with rounds = 0 is rejected (schema min is 2 anyway)

_effectPolarity.notes: Engine classification used by clear (removes positive), cleanse (removes negative), copy (copies positive), mirror (mirrors negative). From isPositiveUserEffect / isNegativeUserEffect.

_runtime.pipelineOrder: damage modifiers -> pierce -> POST_PIERCE_TAGS [lifesteal, drain, poison, afterburn, absorb, recoil, reflect, wound, decreaseheal, increaseheal]
_runtime.damageFloor: 10% of baseDamageAfterBoosts (DMG_REDUCTION_CAP 0.9), applied within the modifier pass; pierce is excluded from that pass
_runtime.percentageModifiers: per-effect multiplicative when scoped (getEfficiencyRatio shares a stat/general/element; empty elements = 'None' scope)
_runtime.damage.allowBloodlineDamageIncrease/Decr: gates whether bloodline-sourced modifiers may touch this damage/pierce packet
_runtime.barrier.absorbPercentage: applies to instant damage only, never residual
_runtime.stun.apReduction: AP removed on stun proc; power is the proc chance
_runtime.seal: suppresses static + bloodline modifier effects in the packet pass

_laws_2026_07.strict_union: Update paths validate per-tag exactly; ANY extra field fails the union (calculation on clear/cleanse, direction 'defence' on reflect). direction is the fixed literal 'offence' on all tags that carry it. Compose from live exemplars only.
_laws_2026_07.generalTypes_required: damage/pierce/wound REQUIRE both statTypes and generalTypes (default ['Highest']); empty generals detonates the damage formula (trillion-damage hits, live-observed).
_laws_2026_07.stacking: Same-type percentage rows stack MULTIPLICATIVELY, total = product(1+p_i), tags and items alike; DDT as product(1-p_i). Pierce bypasses damage modifiers entirely.
_laws_2026_07.item_union: Item-side excludes clear/copy; cleanse/debuffprevent added by the 2026-07 source patch. injectjutsus = permanent join, referenced jutsu uneditable for life, must be born final and unhidden.
_laws_2026_07._see_also: Runtime semantics per tag now live in 46b_DATA_tag_runtime.json v6 (55 source-verified laws, extraction closed 2026-08-01). 46 owns WRITE shapes; 46b owns what the engine DOES.
